services.desc: Scallop with the best and the most experienced Captain/Guide and “The Undisputed Scallop King of Citrus County” Enjoy a scenic ride out the Homosassa River to the BEST scalloping grounds in the state. Every year, from July 1st to September 25th, seafood lovers from all over the Sunshine State and beyond venture to Citrus County for these tasty morsels. Snorkel in crystal clear water usually waist or chest deep over pristine grass flats and bag your limit of these delicious shellfish. Scalloping is part snorkeling experience, part treasure dive and part saltwater fishing experience that can be enjoyed by family members of all ages.
